note: Only publicly free or officially authorised sources belong in this catalogue. Paywalled services, DRM circumvention and unofficial restreams are out of scope by design. Region notes are informational; the app never bypasses geo-restrictions.

leagues.name: English Premier League
leagues.freeCoverage: Live EPL video is a paid rights product in every territory; no legal global free live feed exists. The app shows fixtures, plus free highlights and free-to-air broadcasters in the territories that hold free rights.

leagues.name: UEFA Champions League
leagues.freeCoverage: Matchday live rights are sold per territory. UEFA.tv carries free youth, women's and classic content; some territories have free-to-air live matches via public broadcasters listed here.

leagues.name: La Liga
leagues.freeCoverage: Paid in most territories. RTVE Play carries free national-team and selected free fixtures in Spain.

leagues.name: Serie A
leagues.freeCoverage: Paid in most territories. RAI holds a small free-to-air package in Italy.

leagues.name: Bundesliga
leagues.freeCoverage: ARD/ZDF carry free-to-air matches and highlights in Germany only.

leagues.name: Ligue 1
leagues.freeCoverage: Paid in most territories. France.tv carries free-to-air fixtures where rights allow.

leagues.name: CAF Champions League / AFCON
leagues.freeCoverage: CAF runs free live coverage for a large share of its competitions on its official channels in Africa and beyond; regional exceptions apply.

leagues.name: Major League Soccer
leagues.freeCoverage: A weekly set of MLS matches is free on Apple TV worldwide; the rest of Season Pass is a subscription and is excluded.

leagues.name: Brasileirao Serie A
leagues.freeCoverage: Domestic rights are paid; free matches appear on public broadcasters in Brazil when agreed. Listed broadcasters open on their official pages.

leagues.name: AFC competitions / Asian qualifiers
leagues.freeCoverage: AFC publishes a large share of its competitions free on its official channel; some territories have local free broadcasters.

leagues.name: FKF Premier League (Kenya)
leagues.freeCoverage: Kenyan free-to-air broadcasters carry live league coverage free in Kenya.

leagues.name: International free football
leagues.freeCoverage: FIFA+ streams a rolling schedule of international matches free worldwide, including qualifiers, youth and women's competitions.
